name: Electricity price
desc: The electricity price hour by hour, today and tomorrow

changes.summary: The price on the home screen and hour by hour
points: The price right now at the top of the home screen - turn it off at the top of the app
A line for every krone in the chart, and the arrows show the exact price hour by hour
The prices are remembered and only fetched every 6 hours, at start and at 13:15
